text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism. The elevated TSH combined with low Free T4 confirms an underactive thyroid, which explains your fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, and constipation. We will begin treatment with levothyroxine and monitor your levels in six weeks.
